usedFor: Anchor Browser runs cloud browser sessions, and Telegram gets a chat message from “When a task fails” through “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a task fails” in Anchor Browser, then “Send Message” in Telegram
bestTemplate.why: A failed task reaches your chat, and the message can carry buttons for whoever picks it up.

watchOut: “When a task is cancelled” is a separate trigger from “When a task fails”, so each needs its own template.
